blocks.text: KING OF JUDAH · TWO KINGDOMS
Zedekiah. Eleven years in Jerusalem, the last king of Judah.
REIGNEDi
11 years c. 597–586 BC (dates vary)
CAPITAL
Jerusalem
HOUSE
House of David 20th of 20 in Judah
VERDICT
✕ Did evil “And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.”
PROPHETS
Jeremiah · Ezekiel · Hananiah son of Azur
JUDAH (THE SOUTH): 20 RULERS REHOBOAM → ZEDEKIAH
ACCESSION
How Zedekiah came to power
Nebuchadnezzar made Mattaniah king after taking Jehoiachin, and changed his name to Zedekiah. 2 Kings 24:17 2 Chronicles 36:10
Ezekiel: the king of Babylon "hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him". Ezekiel 17:13
SUCCESSION
The two kingdoms
THE VERDICT
How Scripture judges the reign
“And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.”
2 Kings 24:19 (KJV) →
BUT ALSO
Chronicles: he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar, "who had made him swear by God", and "stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart". 2 Chronicles 36:13
Kings: "through the anger of the LORD" Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon. 2 Kings 24:20
CHRONICLES GIVES IT AS
“And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD.”
2 Chronicles 36:12 (KJV) →
JUDAH (THE SOUTH): 20 RULERS
✓ Did right ✕ Did evil ◐ Mixed ● No verdict formula
THE KINGDOM
Jerusalem and the places of the reign
Judah (the south) · tribe of Judah. Only places Scripture names are shown, each where the Atlas puts it.
EVENTS
Wars, works and turning points
Each mark sits at the year of the reign the Bible gives for it.
UNDATED IN SCRIPTURE
THE NATION
What the nation did
"All the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much" and polluted the temple (Chronicles). 2 Chronicles 36:14
They mocked the LORD's messengers "till there was no remedy". 2 Chronicles 36:16
PROPHETS
Prophets of the reign
Je Jeremiah “If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon’s princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire”
Ez Ezekiel “and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there”
Ha Hananiah son of Azur He broke Jeremiah's yoke and promised peace within two years; Jeremiah said he made the people trust in a lie.
ON THE WORLD STAGE
The powers of the day
BABYLON
Nebuchadnezzar · Nebuzar-adan
EGYPT
Pharaoh-hophra
OUTSIDE THE BIBLE
OUTSIDE THE BIBLE · 597 BC
Babylonian Chronicle 5 (BM 21946)
OUTSIDE THE BIBLE · ABOUT 588–586 BC
The Lachish letters
TWO ACCOUNTS
Where Kings and Chronicles differ
Each ribbon joins the two accounts of one matter, passage to passage.
His relation to Jehoiachin

The day the temple burned

JEREMIAH
What each tells

DATES DIFFER
When was it?
SCRIPTURE'S NUMBERS
No years given
11 years (2 Kgs 24:18). Scripture gives lengths and cross-dates, never BC years.
THIELE, REVISED BY MCFALL (1991)
Printed form: 597–586 (PDF p. 37-38).
YOUNG (2005), REVISING THIELE
Printed form: 597–587 (p. 246 (Table 2)).
ALBRIGHT (1945)
Printed form: 598–587 (p. 22).
TRADITIONAL DATES (USSHER, 1658)
Printed form: 599–588 (p. 86 (scan leaf n48)).
586 BC
E. R. Thiele; L. McFall (1991)
McFall keeps Thiele's date: the city fell on 9 Tammuz, 18 July 586. 2 Kings 25:2–4 [117]
587 BC
W. F. Albright (1945); R. C. Young (2005)
Albright put the storming in August 587; Young dates 9 Tammuz to 587. 2 Kings 25:2–4 Jeremiah 52:5–7 [161][130]
IN SCRIPTURE
Every passage
CHAPTERS · 15
2 Kings 24 2 Kings 25 2 Chronicles 36 Jeremiah 21 Jeremiah 27 Jeremiah 28 Jeremiah 32 Jeremiah 34 Jeremiah 37 Jeremiah 38 Jeremiah 39 Jeremiah 51 Jeremiah 52 Ezekiel 12 Ezekiel 17
PASSAGES · 15

2 Kings 24:17–20 2 Kings 25:1–30 2 Chronicles 36:10–23 Jeremiah 21:1–2 Jeremiah 27:3 Jeremiah 28:1–17 Jeremiah 32:1–5 Jeremiah 34:1–22 Jeremiah 37:1–21 Jeremiah 38:1–28 Jeremiah 39:1–10 Jeremiah 51:59 Jeremiah 52:1–30 Ezekiel 12:12–13 Ezekiel 17:11–21
WHAT SCRIPTURE DOES NOT SAY
Kings and Chronicles do not say when Zedekiah died; Jeremiah says only that he was in prison "till the day of his death".
Scripture does not say Zedekiah saw Babylon; Ezekiel says he would not see it.
IDENTIFICATIONS THIS PAGE RELIES ON
Born Mattaniah; the king of Babylon "changed his name to Zedekiah". Kings calls him Jehoiachin's "father's brother"; he was a son of Josiah. 2 Kings 24:17 Jeremiah 37:1 1 Chronicles 3:15
